title: Are Coreset Selection Methods Worth Their Cost?
abstract: arXiv:2609.22894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coreset selection picks a representative subset of the labeled training set to make training cheaper. However, it is usually evaluated by downstream accuracy at a fixed subset size, ignoring both the time spent selecting the subset and the training recipe behind each reported number. We introduce an end-to-end benchmark that standardizes downstream training and charges selection and training to the same auditable wall-clock budget, spanning 4 datasets from CIFAR-10 to ImageNet-1K, 11 selectors, 5 fractions, and 3 seeds, with over 1,500 released runs. Repeated-sampling work has shown that budget-aware evaluation already favors random strategies. Our two budget studies test whether that verdict survives when every selector is granted its most favorable operating point. Across eight wall-clock budget anchors on each of CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet, no anchor is won by a sophisticated selector: every winner is class-balanced random sampling, r

translated_title: 核心集选择方法物有所值吗？
translated_abstract: 核心集选择通过从带标签的训练集中挑选一个具有代表性的子集来降低训练成本。然而，这类方法通常以固定子集规模下的下游准确率来评估，既忽略了选择子集本身所耗费的时间，也忽略了每个报告数字背后所使用的训练配方。我们提出了一个端到端的基准，该基准将下游训练流程标准化，并把选择与训练的开销计入同一可审计的实际时间预算中，涵盖从CIFAR-10到ImageNet-1K的4个数据集、11种选择器、5种采样比例和3个随机种子，共发布了超过1500次运行结果。已有的重复采样研究表明，基于预算的评估本身就倾向于有利于随机策略。我们的两项预算研究检验了当每个选择器都被赋予其最有利的运行点时，这一结论是否依然成立。在CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet上各自设定的八个实际时间预算锚点中，没有任何一个锚点被复杂的选择器赢得：每个赢家都是类别均衡的随机采样……
tldr: 该论文提出一个端到端、预算感知的评估基准，发现在统一计入选择与训练时间成本后，复杂的核心集选择方法在任何预算档位上都无法胜过简单的类别均衡随机采样。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an end-to-end, budget-aware benchmark showing that, when selection and training costs are charged to the same wall-clock budget, sophisticated coreset selection methods never beat simple class-balanced random sampling at any budget anchor.
